input_file.description: The path to the text file containing the Public Suffix List to be compiled.

output_file.description: The path to the output file where the resulting DAFSA representation will be written.

output_format.description: The format of the output data. 'cxx' outputs C/C++ code, 'cxx+' outputs C/C++ code with stats, 'binary' outputs an architecture-independent binary format.

encoding.description: The encoding mode. 'utf-8' supports UTF-8 and punycode (default), 'ascii' is deprecated and outputs punycode only.
